task.title: Add focused graph lens query API
task.summary: Extend state reads with focused graph lens queries for status, resume, trace, task, sprint, validation, runtime, and automation-readiness subsets.

goal.outcome: Agents and TUI commands can request focused graph/state subsets instead of broad noisy status payloads.
acceptance: State read inputs accept `view` or `lens` plus optional focus/ref/include filters without breaking existing callers.
Lens families exist for status, resume, trace, task, sprint, validation, runtime, and automation-readiness.
Lens responses include source refs, omitted-count metadata, next safe action, blockers, freshness, and expansion hints instead of dumping the full graph.
Existing summary/roadmap/session include behavior remains backward-compatible during migration.
Resume context and status command paths can consume lens output without using chat history as source truth.
Graph lens tests cover status, trace, task/sprint or validation, runtime, and automation-readiness subsets.
non_goals: Do not implement `/wiki system` or `/wiki product` TUI rendering in this task.
Do not remove resume-context compatibility before the tool migration lands.
Do not make generated lens output canonical truth.
